title: Data Breach Response Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Get our free data breach response letter template to request information and protection after your personal data has been compromised.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you formally request information about a data breach affecting your personal data, understand what information was compromised, and demand appropriate protective measures from the organization responsible.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Data Breach Response Request - Account #[Your Account Number]

Dear Data Protection Team,

I am writing in response to the data breach notification I received on [Date of Notification] regarding the security incident that occurred on [Date of Breach]. As an affected individual, I am requesting detailed information about this breach and the steps being taken to protect my personal information.

sections.heading: Information Request
sections.content:
Please provide the following information regarding this data breach:

1. What specific types of personal information were accessed or compromised?
2. How many individuals were affected by this breach?
3. What was the root cause of the security incident?
4. When was the breach discovered and how long did unauthorized access persist?
5. What immediate steps have been taken to secure the compromised systems?
6. Have law enforcement agencies been notified?
7. What long-term security improvements are being implemented?

sections.heading: Protection Measures Request
sections.content:
Given the potential risks to my personal information, I request that your organization provide:

• Free credit monitoring services for a minimum of [Duration] years
• Identity theft protection services
• Regular updates on the investigation progress
• Clear instructions on steps I should take to protect myself
• Reimbursement for any costs incurred due to this breach
• A direct contact for breach-related questions and concerns

sections.heading: Personal Actions Taken
sections.content:
In response to this breach, I have already taken the following protective measures:

• Changed passwords for my account and related services
• Placed fraud alerts with credit bureaus
• Reviewed recent financial statements and credit reports
• Enhanced my online privacy by using tools like Incognito Browser for secure browsing
• [Add any other specific actions you've taken]

placeholders.label: Additional Actions Taken
placeholders.defaultValue: [Add any other specific actions you've taken]

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Contact
sections.content:
I expect a comprehensive response within 30 days of receiving this letter. Please provide all requested information in writing and establish a direct line of communication for ongoing updates.

You can reach me at [Your Phone Number] or [Your Email Address]. I prefer to receive communications via [Preferred Contact Method].

Thank you for your immediate attention to this serious matter. I look forward to your prompt response and the implementation of robust protective measures.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

Enclosures: Copy of breach notification, Account verification documents (if requested)

useCases: Responding to data breach notifications from companies
Requesting detailed information about compromised personal data
Demanding protective services after a security incident
Establishing formal communication with breached organizations
Creating documentation for potential legal action
Following up on inadequate breach notifications
